messages:
Evelyn R.: quick heads up 1 1 about tomorrow's orientation 10:00 my calendar shows the event but there's no join link on the tile. anyone else seeing a blank tile? :wave:
Onboarding Bot: Hi Evelyn! Official join URL: https://zoom.us/j/555333111 (passcode: `Onboard2026`). Agenda & slides will be posted here before the session: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/onboarding_agenda.ics to add to other calendars: https://redwood.app/ical/orientation_master.ics :calendar:
People Ops: We sent two invites earlier (team leads sometimes add their own). Please accept the one from "People Ops / Onboarding" and decline any duplicates. If your calendar still shows no link after accepting, try removing the event and re-importing the .ics.
Evelyn R.: thanks 1 accepted the People Ops invite and now see the Zoom. timezone sanity check: 10:00 PT right? i'm in CET so want to be sure.
Kai N.: 10:00 PT = 13:00 ET = 18:00 UTC = 19:00 CET. For APAC: IST 23:30, SGT 02:00 (next day), AEST 03:00 (next day), NZDT 05:00 (next day). i'll paste a short table in the event description.
Marta G.: will the session be recorded? and where will the recording live? sometimes recordings take a while to process.
Onboarding Bot: Yes, the main session will be recorded and auto-transcribed. Video + transcript will be uploaded to Drive (Drive > Company > New Hires > Sessions) and a link will be posted in #new-hires within ~1 hour after processing. Note: breakout room audio/transcripts are not included in the main transcript.
Ben S.: FYI for folks behind org firewalls that block Zoom: DM People Ops and we can add a Teams dial-in bridge or provide a PSTN dial-in. Also, if you need captions or ASL, let us know ahead of time and we'll arrange.
Evelyn R.: one last tiny issue 1 my event tile shows "Guests can't join" even though i'm internal. should i be worried?
People Ops: That's just the calendar privacy label; ignore it. If anyone actually gets blocked, ping us immediately and we'll escalate with IT. Also, buddy assignments and breakout pre-seeds go out ~24h before the session; if you don't have a buddy an hour beforehand DM Marta and we'll assign one.
Evelyn R.: perfect, thanks everyone! i'll join 5 mins early to check audio. see you tomorrow :wave:
